_comment: Single source of truth for every customer-visible string on the Box display. Edit here, then run `node firmware/i18n/gen.mjs` (add --fonts to regenerate the LVGL font subsets). hi is kept for the record: LVGL cannot shape Devanagari, so the device renders hi as English (see main/i18n.h). Register: de du, es tu, zh-Hans 你, ar MSA. Brand and protocol names (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) stay Latin.

CONVERSATION.note: Quick Settings: start an optional hands-free conversation; orb taps remain OneShot by default

CONVERSATION_STOP.note: Quick Settings: end the active conversation, including while listening or thinking

UPDATE_ERROR.hi: अपडेट उपलब्ध नहीं। फिर कोशिश करें।

CLOUD_RETRY.en: Close and tap Cloud to retry
CLOUD_RETRY.zh-Hans: 关闭后轻触 Cloud 重试
CLOUD_RETRY.hi: बंद करें और Cloud टैप करें

STATUS_CONNECTING.note: Boot status before the first state arrives

STATE_WAKE.note: Status band: wake word / session start

STATE_LISTENING.note: Status band and talk button while the box listens

STATE_ANSWERING.note: Status band: agent is speaking the answer

STATE_ERROR.note: Status band: host reported an error

STATE_SPEAKER_CHECK.note: Status band: speaker not ready yet

TILE_WIFI.note: Quick settings tile (protocol name stays Latin)

TILE_BLUETOOTH.note: Quick settings tile (protocol name stays Latin)

TILE_CHILD_LOCK.note: Quick settings tile, 92 px wide at 14 px: keep it short

LOCK_TAP_LEFT.note: Child-lock hint, exactly one %d = taps still needed
LOCK_TAP_LEFT.zh-Hans: 点按 3 次 - 还剩 %d 次

LOCK_UNLOCKED.note: Child-lock hint after the last tap

NOT_READY.note: Info overlay when a talk start was refused

ERR_OFFLINE.note: Error card: the box has no internet connection (Wi-Fi down, no route, DNS or connect failure)

ERR_SIGNIN.note: Error card: the account sign-in expired or was revoked; pair again from the Cloud tile
ERR_SIGNIN.es: Inicia sesión de nuevo en Cloud
ERR_SIGNIN.zh-Hans: 请通过 Cloud 重新登录
ERR_SIGNIN.hi: Cloud से फिर साइन इन करें

ERR_SERVICE.note: Error card: the voice service or provider is unavailable or timed out

ERR_DENIED.note: Error card: not entitled, budget or quota used up, or rate limited
ERR_DENIED.ar: غير مسموح أو تم بلوغ الحد

ERR_UNKNOWN.note: Error card: any other failure; the technical code is shown below it

ERR_DROPPED.note: Error card, friendly: the voice connection closed mid-turn; no error code is shown

ERR_RETRY.note: Error card second line: tapping the orb starts a new attempt
ERR_RETRY.hi: दोबारा कोशिश के लिए टैप करें

UI2_TAP_TO_TALK.note: Idle pill on the bottom chord (R-1); hides after 3 talks

UI2_MIC_OFF.note: Persistent mute chip on the top chord (R-7)

UI2_HOLD_UNMUTE.note: Mute hint on the bottom chord (R-7)
UI2_HOLD_UNMUTE.hi: चालू करने के लिए दबाकर रखें

UI2_CLOSE.note: Text button that leaves a full-screen flow

ERR_CONSENT.note: Error line when the server needs voice consent (code contains consent)
ERR_CONSENT.en: Allow voice in the kombify app
ERR_CONSENT.es: Permite la voz en la app kombify
ERR_CONSENT.zh-Hans: 请在 kombify 应用中允许语音
ERR_CONSENT.hi: kombify ऐप में आवाज़ की अनुमति दें

UI2_RETRY.note: Retry button under the error line (R-11); the whole screen is the tap target

UI2_WAKEWORD.note: Quick Settings toggle row for the local wake word; the phrase "Hi ESP" follows untranslated

HOME_TEMP.note: RLCD home screen: label under the room temperature

HOME_HUMIDITY.note: RLCD home screen: label under the relative humidity

STATE_TOOL.note: Status pill while the Voice Agent runs a server tool (homelab lookup, smart home)
